There is an interesting feature of Facebook that few people are even aware of and this is the Notes function. It is possible to create a note and then specify who can read it and who can not.

This means (for instance) that it is possible to allow your friends to know where you are while travelling in Columbia while not tipping off potential kidnappers. If you disappear then your friends will at least know your last location.

It has other uses too. One may share lists of resources one is willing to share and resourced one is short of. In this way a low maintenance mutual assistance group is created among trusted people.
